track_name: Beeper: Every Chat in One App
marketing_wrapper: Violet-to-royal-blue vertical gradient backdrop (#5b54f2 at the top to #2b4cf6 at the bottom), a two-line white bold headline in the top ~15%, then an oversized black-bezel modern iPhone cropped at the bottom. 03 and 06 add an enlarged glass sheet (Switch chats, Spaces menu) that breaks out of the phone. Real UI is ~75% of each frame and close to uncropped.

typography.display: System SF Pro: bold 'Inbox' header with a chevron, a large bold blue in-app headline 'Connect Chat Accounts', semibold centred sheet titles (Name & Icon)
typography.numerals: proportional system; time stamps right-aligned (10:45 PM); unread counts in blue pills including mention pills (@ 5, @ 10); muted counts in grey
typography.weights: Bold headers, semibold names, regular grey two-line previews

palette.accent_strategy: One accent: a saturated cobalt blue for outgoing bubbles, unread and mention badges, the confirm checkmark and the 'Connect Chat Accounts' title; per-network colour arrives only through small network badges (WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram) on avatars and the connect grid.
palette.source: palette.json 01–06: #5253f3 / #5750ee / #4f53f4 = violet backdrop, #2b4cf6 / #2f42f6 = blue backdrop bottom, #ffffff = app background, #f0f0f0 / #e5e9ed = grouped surfaces and keyboard. Accent #104cfc, incoming bubble #dbdadf and title #263ebe sampled by pixel from 01, 03 and 05.

shape.radius_language: pill and large: circular glass buttons, capsule search field, bubbles ~18pt with no tail, large circular pinned avatars, ~32pt glass sheets and menus, rounded-square colour/icon picker, squircle app icons in the connect grid
shape.borders_shadows: Soft shadows and light rims on glass controls and sheets; inset hairline dividers in the inbox list
shape.materials: Native Liquid Glass on buttons, menus, the chat-switcher sheet, the floating search capsule and the keyboard; content flat white

liquid_glass_visible: yes (native): glass circle back/more/compose buttons (01–06), a floating glass search capsule with detached close circle (04), a large glass Spaces menu with a + New Space capsule and settings circle (06), a glass Switch chats sheet (03) and the iOS 26 keyboard
density: medium: two-line previews in ~100px rows with 56pt avatars and network badges; a 3-column grid of large pinned-chat circles above the list
layout: Inbox: account/space switcher title with chevron and a compose circle, a grid of pinned contacts as big circles (with a tooltip-style latest message bubble), then the unified list. Chat: back capsule with count, centred avatar over a name capsule, per-network section labels (WhatsApp, LinkedIn) inside one merged thread.
navigation: No tab bar visible; navigation is a title menu that opens a glass Spaces popover (Inbox, Archive, Reminders, Send Later, Low Priority, each account); glass top buttons; sheets for labels; a floating search capsule at the bottom
imagery_and_icons: SF Symbols outline icons; photo and Memoji avatars with small third-party network badges; third-party app icons in the connect grid
signature_visual_move: One person's chats from several networks merge into one thread, with grey network labels between runs and a glass sheet to switch identities.
tells_present: Purple, indigo, violet; purple-to-blue gradient (marketing wrapper only)

direction_fit.primary: none of the 17: native adopter (platform-material overlay), Messages-like
direction_fit.why: The text record exists but left direction and visuals unknown, noting only that iOS was rewritten to match the Android app. The screenshots show a thoroughly iOS 26-native app: Liquid Glass chrome, Messages-style pinned circles and tail-less blue bubbles. Nothing Android-shaped is visible.

notes: Chat anatomy: outgoing tail-less cobalt #104cfc bubbles with white text, incoming light grey #dbdadf; reactions as small grey circles under a bubble; the merged thread inserts centred grey network labels (WhatsApp, LinkedIn) between runs. Composer not shown. Chat list density medium, with Messages-like pinned circles that show a speech-bubble preview. Of the messaging set, Beeper shows the most complete native Liquid Glass (menus, sheets, search capsule), more than WhatsApp or the stale Signal screenshots; compared with Telegram the glass is visually equivalent, so the difference between native and replica glass is not visible in stills.
